newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo Srpska Komercijalna Banka lists its stock.
newsitem.headline: Yugo Srpska Komercijalna Banka lists its stock.

text.p: Yugoslav commercial bank Srpska Komercijalna Banka listed last week 300,000 dinars ($52,934) of its stock on the Belgrade bourse but found no buyers, the Belgrade Stock Exchange (BSE) reported on Monday.
"This was a primary sale of a part of the bank's latest one million dinar issue of participating preference shares," BSE spokesman Milko Stimac told Reuters.
The 12th issue represented 1.88 percent of the total bank's founding capital. All shares were offered at 1,000 dinars face value, Stimac said.
Traders expected Srpska Komercijalna Banka to find buyers of its stock soon as it was "a solid bank, worth investing." -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
